description: This file defines command-line options and setup functions for a Playwright MCP (Managed Control Plane) server, including command decoration, browser installation, and server configuration logic.

methods.name: decorateMCPCommand
methods.description: Adds command-line options and an action handler to configure and start a Playwright MCP server, with support for extension mode and shared browser contexts.

methods.name: decorateMCPInstallBrowserCommand
methods.description: Adds command-line options and an action handler to ensure necessary browsers are installed for Playwright.
